$comment: Verified citations. Every quote here byte-matches its pinned source; run `python tools/cite.py --check`. That the quote EXISTS is mechanical. That it ESTABLISHES its element is a human judgment, recorded in PROVENANCE.md.

citations.quote: An OPO must have a written agreement with 95 percent of the Medicare and Medicaid participating hospitals and critical access hospitals in its service area that have both a ventilator and an operating room and have not been granted a waiver by CMS to work with another OPO.
citations.establishes: The OPO-hospital referral relationship is a written agreement the OPO is required to hold, at a stated coverage threshold of its service area.

citations.quote: The agreement must specify the meaning of the terms “timely referral” and “imminent death.”
citations.establishes: The CFR requires that 'timely referral' be DEFINED IN THE AGREEMENT, and does not define it federally. The response bound is therefore per-hospital and not identical nationally.
